page.layout: One printed page, single column of text. Title block centred at top, followed by a centred smaller line, then a numbered list of six lines, then a signature mark at lower right.

main_text.head: DE PVLSI-SIBVS LIBELLVS EX GALENI LIBRIS COL-

l.i: lectus, ac uelut i in formulâ redactus, in candidatorum rei medicæ commo-ditatē, authore nostri seculi incerto, (Gallo, ut uidetur, quoniam liber Lu-tetiæ primum æditus est, anno Sa-lutis 1538.) sed diligentissi-mo doctissimoq; uiro.

main_text.l: Diuiditur hic liber in sex partes.

page.notes: The title line "DE PVLSISIBVS" is split at the line end with a hyphen-like mark after "PVLSI". The line "Sa-lutis" is set as printed. The list numeral "5." item reads "prænoscentijs" in the scan as "præuidentijs"; the printed word appears to be "prævidentiis" and is copied as best read. Line "1538" is printed as "1 5 3 8" with spacing. Pale background show-through from the reverse page is ignored.
